policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'And he shall be blessed upon the earth' is a passive rendering that fits the qere pual weqatal וְאֻשַּׁר, but the ketiv consonants יאשר admit a pual yiqtol (he shall be blessed) or an impersonal active (one will call him blessed) that English renders identically; the line-initial 'And' is not diagnostic of the waw. The only note (alternative_rendering, 'Or, in the land') concerns 'earth' and does not touch this unit. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
